title: NariQ: Sub-3-Bit Quantization for Long-Horizon Agentic Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2611.26157v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-horizon agentic tasks require a model to call tools over many steps at contexts of 100K tokens or more, yet many low-bit quantization methods are calibrated on short web text and judged on perplexity. This mismatch is costly: existing quantizations of Qwen3.8-27B at or below 3 bits per weight match BF16 on shorter tasks like AIME, yet in published results solve at most 72% as many tasks as BF16 on DeepSWE, a long-horizon agentic benchmark. We propose NariQ, a trellis-coded post-training quantization method that calibrates on tokens generated by the BF16 model in agent sessions. On Qwen3.8-27B, NariQ at 3.0 and 2.5 bits per weight stays level with BF16 on two long-horizon agentic benchmarks, DeepSWE and Terminal Bench, as well as on AIME and RealWorldQA. Our checkpoint at 2.0 bits per weight trails this performance. To our knowledge, these are the first quantizations at or below 3 bits per weight shown to match their full-precision v

translated_title: NariQ：面向长程智能体任务的低于3比特量化方法
translated_abstract: 长程智能体任务要求模型在10万token甚至更长的上下文中经过多步骤调用工具，然而许多低比特量化方法是在短网页文本上进行校准、并仅以困惑度作为评判标准的。这种错配代价高昂：现有的对Qwen3.8-27B在每权重3比特或以下的量化在AIME等较短任务上能与BF16持平，但根据已发表的结果，在长程智能体基准DeepSWE上它们最多只能解决BF16所解决任务的72%。我们提出NariQ，一种格栅编码的后训练量化方法，它使用BF16模型在智能体会话中生成的token进行校准。在Qwen3.8-27B上，NariQ在每权重3.0和2.5比特时在两个长程智能体基准DeepSWE和Terminal Bench以及AIME和RealWorldQA上均与BF16保持持平。我们每权重2.0比特的检查点则略逊于此性能。据我们所知，这些是首个被证明能与全精度版本相媲美的每权重3比特或以下的量化方法。
tldr: NariQ是一种格栅编码后训练量化方法，通过利用BF16模型在智能体会话中生成的token进行校准，首次实现了每权重2.5-3比特量化在长程智能体任务上与全精度模型持平的性能。
en_tdlr: NariQ, a trellis-coded post-training quantization method calibrated on tokens generated by the BF16 model in agent sessions, is the first sub-3-bit quantization shown to match full-precision performance on long-horizon agentic benchmarks.
